changes.to: Maker press release 2026-04-20 announces ψ-SynRobot (also written Psi SynRobot) and the start of volume production; it is described as a general robot platform for complex logistics, retail and industrial sites with 'manipulation + data collection' in one body, 7x24 h continuous operation, bionic multi-joint arms for long-horizon tasks. No height, weight, payload, speed, DOF, battery or runtime figures are published, so all spec fields are left empty. The maker's separate PsiBot V1 product page (<180 cm, 683 mm arm span, >8 h, 4 RGBD + 3 fisheye cameras, Thor compute) is a different model and was not used.
PsiBot's full-stack humanoid platform for logistics, retail and industrial work, built on the PSI foundation models and used to collect manipulation data while it works.
